$about: The stack contract and manifest in one (ADR-016 in the core repo): the same schema the core's standard.manifest.json uses, so the align engine and self-verify read it whole. Paths are the adopted repo's; the reference copy of every merge-class file lives in starter/. An adopting repo carries this file beside standard.manifest.json; self-verify then counts one drift across both layers.
description: Node/TypeScript best practices - Next.js + Fastify through one proxy, Better Auth, tiered testing; distilled from production repos and boot-verified

files.purpose: the Node version pin - one runtime, no drift between machines
lint + format, one tool - the reference copy encodes the strictness the picks assume
strict TypeScript base every package extends
workspace globs + the supply-chain policy (release-age cooldown, allowed build scripts) - the policy block is the point
unit and integration tiers as separate Vitest projects
the e2e tier - real browser journeys against the running app
ephemeral real dependencies for integration/e2e - not mocks
the e2e tier in CI, against the docker test stack
